highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.151.0 restores CPU bitmap-rendering performance and reduces overhead in color and text hot paths.
highlights_body: Built on Skia m151, this release adds span-based parsing and .NET 11 WebAssembly archives. It also releases intermediate subset images promptly and corrects GPU stencil tracking.

breaking.title: Remove whitespace immediately after the color prefix
breaking.body: SKColor.Parse/TryParse now reject whitespace directly after # in the six- and eight-digit forms, matching the stricter short forms. Remove that whitespace before parsing; case-insensitive hexadecimal input and surrounding whitespace remain supported.

bullets.detail: Advances the bundled renderer to milestone m151 without changing the C API in the milestone sync.
Adds ReadOnlySpan<char> overloads for SKColor.Parse/TryParse, SKFourByteTag.Parse, and HarfBuzzSharp.Tag.Parse so slices can be parsed without allocating substrings.
Restores the legacy shader-context path for scaled and tiled CPU bitmap draws, addressing high CPU usage, frame drops, and flicker in software-rendered views.
Corrects stencil clear tracking across surface origins and preserved stencil use, and restores dirty tracking for unexecuted resolves.
Fixes a use-after-free when corrupt Slug data is rejected during native text-buffer deserialization.
Moves SKColor-to-SKColorF and single-value SKPMColor premultiply/unpremultiply math into managed code with native-equivalent results.
Pooled UTF-8 encoding and zero-copy glyph-result reads reduce shaping allocations. Tag parsing avoids scratch arrays while preserving packing, padding, and truncation semantics.
SKImage.FromEncodedData(SKData, SKRectI) disposes the intermediate full image when Subset returns a different image, while preserving same-instance results.
Ships Emscripten 5.0.6 archives with the new exception-handling model for .NET 11 targets, fixing link and browser startup failures. .NET 8 and .NET 9/10 retain their existing archive mappings.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Added .NET 11 WebAssembly archives, removed redundant WASM build warnings, and introduced cross-backend visual regression coverage.

preview_summaries.v4.151.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 opened the line with Skia m151.
preview_summaries.v4.151.0-preview.2.1: Preview 2 added span-based color and tag parsing, reduced shaping allocations, and fixed native text-buffer cleanup. Color parsing now rejects whitespace immediately after # in long forms.
preview_summaries.v4.151.0-rc.1.1: Release Candidate 1 restored scaled-bitmap CPU performance, accelerated color math, and fixed subset-image cleanup. It also added .NET 11 WebAssembly compatibility and GPU stencil corrections.

harfbuzz_summary: Buffer.AddUtf8(string) uses pooled encoding, and Tag.Parse adds a span overload while avoiding its scratch array. WebAssembly packages also supply the Emscripten 5.0.6 archive for .NET 11 targets.

v4.151.0-preview.1.1.headline: SkiaSharp 4.151.0 Preview 1 introduces the Skia m151 engine.

v4.151.0-preview.2.1.headline: Preview 2 adds span-based parsing and reduces text-shaping overhead.

v4.151.0-rc.1.1.headline: Release Candidate 1 restores CPU bitmap performance and adds .NET 11 WebAssembly compatibility.

v4.151.0.headline: SkiaSharp 4.151.0 is the stable shipment of the previously previewed release line.
